rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a customer or client.

example.english: This customer shops with us all the time.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 haak3 sing4 jat6 bong1 can3 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this especially for a customer in a shop, restaurant, hotel, or other service setting, though it can also mean guest.

example.english: The customer said they wanted another iced lemon tea.
example.traditional: 客人話要加多杯凍檸茶。
example.jyutping: haak3 jan4 waa6 jiu3 gaa1 do1 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4

rows.note: Use this formal business or written term when referring to customers or clients collectively or professionally.

example.english: The company regularly collects customer feedback.
example.traditional: 公司會定期收集顧客意見。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 ding6 kei4 sau1 zaap6 gu3 haak3 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written contexts for a patron or established customer of a business.

example.english: This shop has always valued each customer.
example.traditional: 本店一向重視每位主顧。
example.jyutping: bun2 dim3 jat1 hoeng3 zung6 si6 mui5 wai2 zyu2 gu3
